about_the_game:
《Magic Scavenger Demo》includes:

  • Full Game Experience: Experience the complete gameplay loop from entering the map to looting and extracting with your haul

  • Lootable Items: Dozens of items available for scavenging

  • Enemy Types: Currently features 2 enemy variants

To earn money, you venture into unknown lands. Scavenge treasures, craft spells, and escape pursuing enemies. Now, go forth and begin your adventure!

Loot Treasures

Various treasures are scattered across the map. Roam the area and pick out the most valuable ones to take with you.

Craft Diverse Spells

Combine the spell scrolls you've scavenged in various ways—this will be your key to overcoming

Proper time management and timely evacuation are crucial

During your adventure, you must always keep an eye on your remaining evacuation time. Exceeding the time limit will result in failure.

Plan wisely to loot treasures within the limited time and locate the evacuation point to extract your haul.

Enemies lurking in the dark night

You must face the enemies hidden in the night—they will be your greatest obstacle. Once they spot you, they will give chase!

Brave the enemies of the night!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a light Rogue-like spell-building looting and extraction game. To earn money, you embark on an adventure—scavenging valuable items, crafting your spells, and fending off waves of enemies before extracting with your haul. How much treasure can you escape with?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
